success_definitions.hit3: At least one first-three-year league-wide positional finish of QB/RB/TE top 12 or WR top 24.
success_definitions.star3: At least one first-three-year league-wide positional finish of QB/RB/TE top 6 or WR top 12.

calibration_types.pooled_reference: Matches the current 2026 percentile interpretation by ranking each historical OOF score inside the complete same-position OOF reference distribution.
calibration_types.prior_only_reference: Stricter temporal robustness check: each historical score is ranked only against OOF scores from earlier draft classes, requiring at least 30 earlier reference players.

note: Stage 5A is interpretation/calibration only. Frozen Stage 3 models, Stage 4 audit logic, targets, feature selection, and 2026 predictions are unchanged.
